==Description==
'''Hot Spot''' is an {{Color|Insane}} [[Maps|map]] that takes place on a desolated wasteland with open vents around it.

==Design & Path==
'''Hot Spot''' is a desert-like wasteland map featuring multiple lava lakes formed by leaking pipes, and scattered debris including broken lampposts, electrical poles, pipes and industrial wreckage. There are two buildings on this map, one is a burning building with a broken roof and lava visible on the inside and a small boarded up gas station. The entrances start at:
*The '''Middle Entrance''' is a glowing green portal with a digital appearance.
*The '''Left Entrance''' is a dilapidated gas station with windows barricaded by wooden planks.
*The '''Right Entrance''' is a metal building emitting flames from its broken roof.
They all end at an entrance to an underground vault.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Hot Spot}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Insane|Modifiers = 1.1|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*Towers should be placed either around the middle of the map or the back, as it allows for towers to cover all three paths.
**The intersection at the back may be more ideal for towers with really low range, such as the [[Warden]] or [[Shotgunner]], as they are unlikely to cover three paths otherwise.
*Due to how large the area of this map is, high range or ability to move their range, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]], [[Brawler]] or [[Gatling Gun]] can be quite useful here.
**The [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the range of your towers, making covering all the paths far easier.
